draft_validation: Unchanged EventCreate/EventPatch base schema: title length, bounded plain-text fields, canonical unique IDs <=12, catalogue existence, UTC/date ordering. No category-specific requirement for draft saving.
published_edit_policy: Enforce new requirements when changing category or when an existing publication already meets the contract. Legacy V1 incomplete publications may receive same-category corrections without a data backfill; no republish.
author_speaker_contract: Use existing summary and description; no new presenter field.
data_preservation: All generic field values and ordered selected canonical work IDs survive preset switches; unavailable book IDs shown explicitly for removal, never silently dropped.

responsive.method: Compensated in-app viewport display scaling, then verified exact rendered DOM dimensions; screenshots are provider-scaled captures.

general_user_permissions: Unchanged; read-only and management 403 verified by existing Events real-Mongo tests.
limitations: No dedicated speaker field; use summary/description.
Legacy V1 incomplete publications keep same-category correction compatibility.
Responsive DOM dimensions verified at all four exact sizes; screenshot files are scaled/clipped by the in-app provider and should not be treated as full-resolution exports.
Local latency samples are not a large-catalogue benchmark. Search path unchanged; browser picker measurements include automation overhead.
Existing 10 security fixture skips and 19 lint warnings remain.
